summary: Each invocation permits at most ten forwarded arguments and creates exactly one source call, timer, and two-promise race, so the legal domain is too small for an honest runtime scaling verdict and wall-clock duration belongs to the supplied promise.

workload_bound.source_constraint: inputs.length is between zero and ten and the time limit is between zero and 1000 milliseconds

replacement_checks.evidence: Each wrapper invocation forwards a arguments once, creates one rejecting timer and one Promise.race over two promises, then clears the timer in a finally block.
Cases cover zero and ten arguments, zero and maximum limits, immediate and delayed resolution, immediate and delayed rejection, timeout wins, and equal delayed timers.
